belief_statement: Preliminary evidence indicates that few image wall wooden may influence friendliness poms. The evidence base (2 findings, 1 studies) is growing but not yet conclusive.

mechanisms.pathway: soft_fascination → involuntary attention → directed attention recovery
natural_stimuli → parasympathetic activation → cortisol reduction → stress relief

latent_variables.name: Mechanism selection
latent_variables.rationale: Multiple mechanisms are implicated (Attention Restoration Theory (Kaplan), Stress Recovery Theory (Ulrich), Psychophysics / Perception). A latent variable may determine which pathway is activated.

latent_variables.name: Dose and duration
latent_variables.rationale: Most studies measure presence/absence of few image wall wooden, not dose-response curves. Duration and intensity likely matter.
latent_variables.suggested_measure: Parametric variation of intensity and exposure duration

research_needs.question: Does the effect of few image wall wooden on friendliness poms replicate in a pre-registered RCT?
research_needs.rationale: Current confidence is moderate. A well-powered pre-registered replication would most efficiently resolve the status of this belief.

research_needs.question: Which mechanism best explains few image wall wooden → friendliness poms?
research_needs.rationale: 3 candidate mechanisms exist. Process tracing would identify the active pathway.

research_needs.question: What is the dose-response curve for few image wall wooden effects on friendliness poms?
research_needs.rationale: Dose-response data enables design guidelines with specific thresholds.
